Change c0496. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): I indeed perceptibly gained on it; and when, after nearly two days' journey, I beheld my enemy at no more than a mile distant, my heart bounded within me.

1818 text: But now, when I appeared almost within grasp of my enemy, my hopes were suddenly extinguished, and I lost all trace of him more utterly than I had ever done before.

1831 text: But now, when I appeared almost within grasp of my foe, my hopes were suddenly extinguished, and I lost all trace of him more utterly than I had ever done before.

Diff: But now, when I appeared almost within grasp of my [-enemy-] {+foe+} , my hopes were suddenly extinguished, and I lost all trace of him more utterly than I had ever done before.

Context after (unchanged): A ground sea was heard; the thunder of its progress, as the waters rolled and swelled beneath me, became every moment more ominous and terrific.

result.rationale: Single synonym swap, 'enemy' to 'foe', with no change in meaning or events; a minor diction choice, possibly avoiding repetition of 'enemy' from the preceding sentence.
